The house

Renovated with care, made for slow days.

Doreen’s House is a renovated home in Mytilene with two bedrooms, a spacious living and dining room, a comfortable kitchen and a bathroom. Deep emerald walls, brass lights and a gold arched mirror give it the warmth of an old town house, with everything new.

Outside, a large courtyard waits for the afternoon. And the town is right there: the main shopping street a minute away, the castle very close, the centre and the harbour a relaxed ten-minute walk.

Walk through the rooms
Room tour

Step inside, room by room.

One bright open space with the emerald wall, brass pendant lights, a large sofa and a table for four.

A comfortable kitchen with an oven, ceramic hob, microwave, a large fridge and a small table for breakfast.

A queen bed, a round gold mirror with a dressing table, and a window with a Roman blind.

A double bed with a bunk above — the room children love.

A bathroom with a walk-in shower, a bowl basin and brass details — and the hallway with the big wall clock that joins the rooms.

The courtyard

The best hour is the afternoon.

A large paved courtyard with a young tree in the middle, a table for eating outside, and the light softening behind the tiled roofs. Your own corner of town, for coffee, a long lunch or the children’s games.

The town

Mytilene, at your door.

Harbour promenades along the waterfront, neoclassical mansions above the streets, ouzeries and a castle among the pines. You walk everywhere — and when you drive, the main road is right next to you.

Questions

Before you travel.

At a glance

Doreen’s House is a renovated holiday home in central Mytilene, Lesvos (811 00), for up to 4 guests: 2 bedrooms (a queen bed; a double bed with a bunk), 1 bathroom, a living and dining room, a full kitchen, a large courtyard with outdoor dining, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating and a washing machine. A 10-minute walk to the centre, the harbour and Tsamakia beach, a minute from the main shopping street, close to the castle; easy street parking. Check-in after 15:00, check-out by 11:00; hosted by Harry, an Airbnb Superhost. Registration no. (AMA) 00003439728.

Where is Doreen's House?

In a central spot of Mytilene, on Lesvos: a 10-minute walk from the centre and the harbour, a minute from the main shopping street and very close to the castle. Harry sends you the exact address after you book.

How many guests does it sleep?

Up to 4. Bedroom 1 has a queen bed and bedroom 2 a double bed with a bunk. There is one bathroom.

Is it suitable for families with children?

Yes. Children love the bunk in the second bedroom, the courtyard is spacious, and the castle and the town’s parks are very close.

Is there parking?

Street parking is relatively easy in the area, with direct access to the main road.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is after 3 pm and check-out by 11 am. Quiet hours are 22:00–08:00.

How far is the sea?

Tsamakia, Mytilene’s town beach, is about a 10-minute walk away, with parks and the ancient theatre nearby.

How do I book?

Pick your dates and guests in the form on this page: the home’s Airbnb page opens with your dates, so you can see the price and book securely.

Are pets or smoking allowed?

No. Pets, smoking (including vaping), parties and events are not allowed.
